notes: Prices in USD per 1M tokens, standard (non-batch) API tier. Tiered-price models record the base (lowest) tier with the higher tier in the model's note field. Retired models excluded; deprecated-but-available models included. Collected Tuesday 2026-11-10 (UTC), 15 days after the previous file. No snapshot exists for 2026-11-02 or 2026-11-09; both weeks were missed and are not backfilled, so every change below may have happened at any point since 2026-10-26. retrieved_at is the session time; the fetch tool returned no per-page timestamp. The set goes from 54 to 55 rows. Three rows arrive: claude-fable-5-2 and claude-mythos-5-2 ($8.00/$40.00, cache read $0.20, 20% below Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1 on input and output), and gpt-6.1-terra ($1.00/$5.00, cache read $0.05). Two rows leave: mistral-medium-3.5 and mistral-large-3. mistral.ai/pricing/api now 301-redirects to docs.mistral.ai/inference/pricing, whose price table lists Mistral Large 4, Mistral Small 4, Codestral and Ministral 3 but not Medium 3.5 or Large 3. Both still have model pages on the docs site, so they are dropped for lack of an observable price, not recorded as retired. One carried row repriced: Mistral Large 4 to $0.70/$2.10, cached input $0.07 (-48.5% input and output, -50% cache read), reversing the 2026-10-26 increase; see its note. The other 51 carried rows are unchanged on input, output and cache-read price. Google's pricing, deprecations and changelog pages now 301-redirect from ai.google.dev to aistudio.google.com/docs; Google source_url values are updated. Google's changelog entry of 2026-11-02 deprecates gemini-2.5-pro (routes to gemini-3.8-flash) and gemini-2.5-flash (routes to gemini-3.5-flash-lite), both effective 2026-12-01. gemini-omni-1.2-flash was released 2026-11-05 (video model, outside scope). OpenAI now states gpt-5.6-sol's promotional pricing is available until 2026-11-30. OpenAI's deprecations page added one entry after 2026-10-14: gpt-5.5-cyber-preview, dated 2026-11-05, removal 2027-02-01 (outside scope). The Cyber table now also lists gpt-6-cyber ($20.00/$100.00, cached $2.00), outside scope. Anthropic's deprecations page has no notice after 2026-09-30. claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 is still Active, 26 days past its 'not sooner than October 15, 2026' floor; with the 60-day minimum notice its earliest possible retirement is now 2027-01-09 (our calculation). claude-opus-4-5-20251101 reaches its floor on 2026-11-24. Anthropic removed temperature, top_p and top_k in API version 2026-10-21 (not a price change). DeepSeek and xAI: no change on any row. DeepSeek's change log has no entry after 2026-10-17; per-request Search and Fetch billing ($0.75 per 1,000 successful requests each) is now listed on the pricing page. Dated events ahead: claude-sonnet-4-5 retires 2026-11-30; the gpt-5.6-sol promotion ends 2026-11-30; on 2026-12-01 Gemini 4 Argon doubles to $4.00/$20.00 and gemini-2.5-pro and gemini-2.5-flash route away; gemini-3.8-flash and gemini-3.6-flash double to $1.50/$7.50 on 2027-01-01. Carried statements unchanged: Claude 4.7 and later models use a newer tokenizer the page says produces approximately 30% more tokens for the same text, so the affected rows (now thirteen, including claude-fable-5-2 and claude-mythos-5-2) cost more per unit of text than a per-token comparison shows. Anthropic's inference_geo 'us' and xAI's US regional endpoint each apply a 1.1x multiplier; OpenAI charges a 10% uplift on regional processing for models released on or after 2026-03-05. DeepSeek peak hours (01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00 UTC, weekdays excluding Chinese public holidays) double the off-peak rates recorded here. Mistral prices were confirmed against the raw page HTML; other providers' figures were read from fetched page text.
